label: late original phase / delimiter, after several s,b,a,k,l,d tokens
explanation: Fires only in the encoding phase at positions t>=5 (rate rises with position, ~10% at orig_idx 8) and on the <DEL> step (19% of mass); never in the copy phase and never at t<=3. Within that window it is diffuse: rate is boosted when earlier inputs include s,b,a,k,l,d (especially as the first token: first_tok s 4.3x, b 3.7x) and when the current input is c (5.4x), <DEL>, 1, 2, t, j or e; f is suppressive. Firing is mostly on first occurrences of a token (90% of mass). The window alone captures 97% of mass at 5% precision; requiring >=2 of {s,b,a,k,l,d} seen earlier keeps ~80% mass at ~10% precision. Best tested F1 ~0.30 (first_tok in set and current token in high set), so the unit looks like a graded, distributed sum over sequence content rather than a crisp condition. Top activations (max) are on c right before <DEL> in sequences starting with s/b/d.
